parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The ID of the image file that is used to reset the instance.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description:
The password of the instance.

It must be 8 to 30 characters in length. It must include at least three of the following characters types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The following special character are supported: `()'~! @#$%^&*-_+={}[]:;'<>,.?/`

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens reinit-instance --instance-id i-5vn4n3y4laeb0000000ltlvzi --image-id m-5wn1dh0000000b48f440ntvad --password Example123@ --region cn-hangzhou
